title: The Lake That Swallowed the Sun
subtitle: A Novel of Water, Gates and Old Promises
blurb: On Two-Light Lake, a highland lake shaped like a sun and a moon, the east half drains to mud overnight while the west half rises toward the village. Sixteen-year-old Shu Tsai, apprentice to her grandfather the lake's silent gatekeeper, has thirty days before the Mid-Autumn storm and a vote on a lowland company's concrete dam. With a ferry boy who tells terrible jokes, a little brother with a duckling, a rival engineer who learns to listen and an old legend about a golden axe and golden scissors, she climbs the sacred mountain, measures the whole lake and finds out what the two stone dragons really are. Inspired by a Taiwanese lake legend.
author: Yang
